tools.name: atlas_orient
tools.description: Find Atlas entries by topic when you hold no id; an id you already hold can be read directly. Searches Nodes (patterns, concepts, examples) and Roadmap entries (announced, unpublished); kind narrows it to one Node kind, Decisions, or glossary terms. Node discovery preserves leading lexical matches a

tools.name: atlas_cards
tools.description: Get one summary Card per Atlas Node id: its Hook (one-line summary) and the publisher's claims (thesis, law, when-to-reach, or claim), each citing its source Sections. Use when you hold ids and want their guidance without full text, such as to compare entries. Cards return in request order. Atomic:

tools.name: atlas_read
tools.description: Read the full text at one exact Atlas address. A bare Node id returns the whole entry: identity, tree position, Hook (one-line summary), and every Section; relationship occurrences are omitted. A Section, Decision, or glossary term address returns that one item. Use when a summary is not enough or y

tools.name: atlas_links
tools.description: List where one Atlas Node references other entries (outbound) and where they reference it (inbound), outbound first. Use to find related entries or what points at this one. Each occurrence gives direction, class, source Section, and the far end's Hook (one-line summary), plus its id and title unless

tools.name: atlas_navigate
tools.description: Browse the whole Atlas in the publisher's order: the canonical tree of every published Node, or the guided first learning path, an introduction then steps each naming a Node id with narration. Use to survey what exists or to start learning with no topic in mind. Neither view carries entry text or cl

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "atlas_orient" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
